THE CREATION OF A DESIGN METHODOLOGY WILL BE THE BASIS FOR ENTIRE PROGRAM.  UNDER THIS TASK, THE CURRENT DESIGN OPTIMIZATION PROCESS WILL BE TRANSPOSED INTO A SUCCINCT METHODOLOGY THAT CAN BE VISUALIZED AND ANALYZED. THE METHODOLOGY WILL THEN BE CODIFIED AND TESTED ON EXISTING DATA SETS.  WHERE NEEDED, ADDITIONAL COMPUTATIONAL SIMULATIONS WILL BE PERFORMED TO ENHANCE THE DESIGN SPACE.  THE TOOL WILL THEN BE EXTENDED TO ALLOW FOR ENTIRELY NEW DATA SETS.  IN THIS CASE, THE TOOL WILL INDICATE WHAT AREAS OF THE DOMAIN REQUIRE MORE SIMULATIONS AND WHEN THE COMPUTATIONAL METHOD NEEDS TO BE ENHANCED TO ALLOW FOR MORE ACCURATE SOLUTIONS.
